Check status before launch
Open buymw4cheats.com and read the live status banner. Check Discord #status for tier loaders and utility modules.
Yellow or red for your tier means wait—do not queue Ranked until green or staff post reload instructions. Assumption kills accounts faster than losing rank.
Reload loader and configs
Download the latest patch build from your operator portal—do not reuse yesterday’s executable. Reload Ranked preset configs instead of tweaking individual sliders.
Pull the latest cloud sync bundle first per [external cheat guide](/blog/mw4-external-cheat-guide/). Delete old loader shortcuts pointing to outdated paths.
Lobby verification
Run a five-minute private lobby or bot match. Confirm player ESP distances, drop icons, and script combo fire correctly.
If overlays float offset from models, stop and open Discord with your Modern Warfare client version. Never “test in Ranked” when ESP is misaligned.
Conservative first session
After patches, play Warzone or casual queues before Ranked. Use ESP-only or high-delay aimbot—no max Auto finish or full bots on day zero.
Shorter games and fewer stomps normalize telemetry after client updates. Elite operators still follow conservative day-zero rules.
Verify error vs ban
Launch Modern Warfare vanilla once before loader if you see anti-cheat verify errors—read [Ricochet anti-cheat unable to verify](/blog/ricochet-bypass-mw4-guide/) before assuming HWID issues.
File integrity scan on PC fixes most verify errors unrelated to cheat loaders.
Stay updated at buymw4cheats.com
Patch notes hit Discord before the blog. Bookmark [Modern Warfare Cheats](/products/mw4-cheats/) status and keep operator portal access handy for emergency loader downloads.
Subscribe to status pings if available—patch evenings are highest risk windows for outdated builds.
